summary: Build route optimization, dispatch control, and delivery KPI skills in 5 days. Train with practical tools and real operational workflows.
lede: Delivery optimization training helps delivery planning, fleet, and distribution professionals plan routes and manage the final leg of order fulfillment. It covers route design around time windows and vehicle capacity, dispatch and fleet allocation, and recovery workflows for delays or failed deliveries. Participants also calculate service and cost measures, review delivery dashboards, and use performance data to identify route improvements and communicate with customers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in delivery planning, fleet coordination, or distribution control and now need stronger command of last-mile delivery operations. It is also suitable for leaders who must translate service pressure, cost pressure, and digital visibility into better routing and dispatch decisions.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of transport or distribution operations, basic familiarity with delivery KPIs, and comfort using spreadsheets for route or performance analysis. You do not need coding skills, but you should be ready to work with delivery data, service-level reports, and planning templates. Participants should bring a laptop for dashboard exercises and route-planning templates. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted route optimization are covered at an operational interpretation level, not as engineering or software development work.
